# vis-network

This directory vendors `vis-network` 10.1.0 for offline use by the local
knowledge-graph viewer.

- Project: https://github.com/visjs/vis-network
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vis-network
- Vendored build: `standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js`
